scripts.dev:local: eval $(supabase status -o env) && NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=$API_URL NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=$PUBLISHABLE_KEY SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=$SECRET_KEY next dev
scripts.db:test: docker exec -i supabase_db_kori psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < supabase/tests/isolation.sql
scripts.db:test:provisionnement: docker exec -i supabase_db_kori psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < supabase/tests/provisionnement.sql
scripts.seed:terms:local: eval $(supabase status -o env) && NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=$API_URL SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=$SECRET_KEY node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/seed-terms.mts
